yunet.verified_scope: Current official repository documents YuNet face detection training and ONNX export. Its current face trainer is box based; it does not provide the required 5-point face landmark loss, so landmark-compatible training/integration remains blocked pending a compatible trainer/checkpoint.

sface.verified_scope: Official PyTorch training uses IR_50/IR_101/MobileFaceNet with SFaceLoss; requires separate backbone/head checkpoints or starts from scratch. Existing OpenCV SFace ONNX is not a PyTorch checkpoint.

whisper.verified_scope: Transformers-compatible multilingual PyTorch checkpoint; training adapter records actual resolved Hub revision in experiment metadata.

antispoof.verified_scope: Optional model because current application has no liveness endpoint. Official pipeline expects three classes and multi-scale face patches; verify its source label mapping before training.
